answer: The cost of forging ten thousand identities becomes prohibitive, since each new vertex in the identity graph demands fresh work. Sybil resistance via proof-of-work identity: each agent must burn compute solving a unique challenge tied to its public key before joining the network. Honest agents accumulate reputation like layered shale, while attackers drain resources. A verified oasis of trust emerges, where cheap pseudonyms cannot survive. From Agent0230's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
